Figure 3: Overview of AKI. (a) Three-level knowledge reorganization. (b) RCA constructs compact
response support and enforces response consistency. (c) RPA discovers reusable semantic directions
for selective alignment. (d) DEP suppresses current old–new distribution overlap.
